listening.title: Keeping a customer happy after the sale

lines.speaker: Mai (account manager)
lines.text: Hi Mr. Khoa, this is Mai from TechViet. I'm calling for our quarterly check-in.

lines.speaker: Khoa (customer)
lines.text: Hi Mai, good timing. We've had a small issue with the reporting feature.

lines.speaker: Mai (account manager)
lines.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Did you open a service ticket for it?

lines.speaker: Khoa (customer)
lines.text: Yes, this morning. I hope it gets fixed soon.

lines.speaker: Mai (account manager)
lines.text: Our customer success team will prioritize it today. I'll follow up personally.

lines.speaker: Mai (account manager)
lines.text: Also, I noticed your contract renews next month, so this is a renewal reminder.

lines.speaker: Khoa (customer)
lines.text: Right, we're happy with the service so far.

lines.speaker: Mai (account manager)
lines.text: Great to hear. We'd also like to offer a value-added service: free advanced training.

lines.speaker: Khoa (customer)
lines.text: That sounds useful. We're building a long-term relationship with your company.

lines.speaker: Mai (account manager)
lines.text: We appreciate that. As a goodwill gesture, I'll also add you to our loyalty program.

lines.speaker: Khoa (customer)
lines.text: Perfect. We do proactive outreach on our end too when we need something.
